notes: Compressed long-session proxy for DeepSeek Harness: four prompts in one TUI session, with turn 3 requiring one successful bash pwd call. The DSH v3 transcript has explicit turn/start and turn/end records. Assistant messages and tool call/result records are non-terminal, so each turn must stay continuously working until its completed turn/end. Transcript assertions require exactly four durable turns, exactly one successful bash round, and no approval request. The phase chain binds all four arcs to the first session that enters working, so a transient proc-<PID> row cannot satisfy the turns. The final state is ready.
